title: skills(objectstack-ui): the dashboards rule tells authors to override a compareTo series with `series.dashArray` / `series.opacity` — a dashboard widget's `chartConfig.series` is a tombstone the schema refuses by name
body:
Filing gate: **① a defect, class (c)** (a metadata-authoring trap in a published skill), `reach:` a named real producer: the published skill text itself, `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`, which ships to customer projects through `npx skills add objectstack-ai/objectstack/skills` and instructs an AI author to write the key. Filed by the `domain:spec` seat 1 (`session_01UtnxvdiN376GF3sgXwAw4d`, seat post #6017) from the #21131 dev report (`5935805280`, `out_of_scope_findings` 3), which the at-tier contract review of PR #21205 (`5936107820`, ③ OOS-3) escalated for a `domain:skills` card. ⛔ Filed bare: routing and grading are triage's. ⛔ Not a claim.

**Who acts on it:** the `domain:skills` lane (`skills/**` is Tier H; a docs-only PR for the maintainer's click). ⚠️ PR #21205 (`Part of #21131`, Tier H, open) edits two other sites of the same file; whoever takes this works after or beside it.

## The text

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/dashboards.md`, the `compareTo` "Cartesian charts" bullet (about `:257`-`:262` on `origin/main` `2c1cef3345`):

> muted per family (dashed `'4 4'` on line/area only; reduced opacity on all). Override per-series with `series.dashArray` / `series.opacity`.

## Why it is a trap

- On a dataset-bound dashboard widget, `chartConfig.series` is a `retiredKey` tombstone (`packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts`, about `:963`): "Per-series appearance (label, colour, mark type, stacking) is not authorable on a dataset-bound widget; `colors` on this same chart config is the palette channel that remains."
- The chart config's own describe (about `:968`) states that `type`, `xAxis`, `yAxis` and `series` "are refused here".
- `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx` ("What `chartConfig` does not carry") says the same.
- So an AI following the skill writes a key the schema refuses at parse. The refusal is loud and carries a prescription, but the skill is the source of the wrong instruction (NORTH-STAR priority 4: a wrong sentence in a skill is a product defect).

## Not measured

- A served `os validate` run on a stack carrying `chartConfig.series`: the refusal is read from the tombstone and its describe, not from a run.
- Whether the bullet means the dashboard widget at all, or a renderer-internal series option. The section is the dashboards rule's `compareTo` guidance, which is about dashboard widgets; the taker confirms.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Delete the override sentence, or replace it with the one channel that remains (`chartConfig.colors`), within the skills token ratchet (net lines ≤ 0).

## Dedupe

Open issues (152, REST, all pages) and the 183 most recently updated closed issues, grepped locally: `dashArray` 0, `series.opacity` 0; `compareTo` 1 hit, #20760 (a different concern); `dashboards.md` 1 hit, #21131 (the source). Control: `chartConfig` 2 hits in the same corpus.

Dedupe words: dashboards skill series dashArray opacity · compareTo override per-series chartConfig.series tombstone · skill teaches refused chartConfig key
